scene_capture_contract.stable_ui_screen_formula: 4 scenes x 3 states (A guide, B recording, C review)

fields.empty_rule: omit G03; never invent replacement copy

look_pipeline.analysis_scope: per scene, sampled once; fixed parameters within each scene to prevent exposure flicker

edit_timeline.rule: temporal source mapping remains continuous and 1.0x inside every merchant scene

speech_continuity.source_audio_policy: detach each scene audio, concatenate at exact scene boundaries, never retime, never slice words at internal visual cuts
speech_continuity.internal_hard_cuts: transform/crop changes only; source time remains continuous
speech_continuity.S3_face_rule: no source-frame drop, duplication, speed change or mouth occlusion
speech_continuity.future_audio_phase: preserve validated 120 BPM grid, ducking, non-repetition and sector identity; no speech subtitles

fallbacks.accroche_empty: omit G03 and leave food image clean
fallbacks.long_product: fit 84->52 px; then split at nearest word boundary into two balanced lines; never truncate
fallbacks.long_name: fit 62->42 px; maximum two lines; never remove accents
fallbacks.bright_background: increase soft radial darkening up to 0.22; never draw a rectangular scrim
fallbacks.face_detected: move non-CTA text away from face; CTA only in S4
fallbacks.missing_font: fail with explicit error; do not substitute

android_media3_contract.composition: EditedMediaItemSequence for S1..S4; frame-continuous transforms per scene
android_media3_contract.hard_cuts: single-sequence concatenation or matrix-state discontinuity; zero overlap
android_media3_contract.color: custom GlEffect implementing LUT/split-tone/vignette; deterministic uniforms per scene
android_media3_contract.text: pre-rasterized transparent overlays from bundled TTFs or Android Canvas with exact typefaces
android_media3_contract.mask_reveal: animated clip rect / shader x-threshold; one overlay sequence
android_media3_contract.decoder_budget: one video decoder; no two-stream crossfade
android_media3_contract.audio_future: original scene audio remains at 1.0x; music/SFX phase separate

revision.purpose: freeze a complete template-side handoff before music calibration

price_format.numeric_display_grouping: groups of 3 digits separated by a regular protected space

impact_transition_system.base_edit: single-frame hard cuts remain at the exact declared cut frames

android_media3_mapping.directional_blur_flash_chromatic_sweep: single custom GlEffect with uniforms driven by presentation time

premium_transition_choreography.principle: effects evolve by narrative phase; no identical pulse repeated through the full film

phases.intent: optical focus and warm macro energy
silk slides, aperture bloom and rack focus
face-safe luma bloom then clean editorial crop changes
architectural sweeps then stable luxury resolve

android_media3_mapping.all_optical_effects: one custom GlEffect selected by event name and presentation-time uniforms

implementation_handoff.purpose: single JSON handoff for merchant data, the 12 capture screens, four media slots and the deterministic renderer
implementation_handoff.binding_syntax: RFC 6901 pointer for files; runtime.* for values produced by the application

visual_proof_only.note: The PNG verifies the contract visually; production code consumes this JSON, not the PNG or HTML simulation.

resolved_text.title: LE PLAT
resolved_text.instruction: Approche ton téléphone tout près du plat bien chaud pour montrer tous les détails. Commence un peu loin puis rapproche-toi doucement.

navigation_rules.back_from_review: return to A_GUIDE for the same scene; never enter B_RECORDING directly
navigation_rules.retake: delete only the current scene file and return to its A_GUIDE screen
navigation_rules.accept_s1_to_s3: persist current capture and open next scene A_GUIDE
navigation_rules.process_death_recovery: restore the last accepted capture slots; any incomplete B_RECORDING file is discarded

runtime_invariants: require all four accepted capture URIs before render

android_mapping.screen_model: CaptureScreenModel(screenId, sceneId, state, resolvedText, visibleComponents, actions)
android_mapping.recommended_state_holder: ViewModel + SavedStateHandle; persist accepted content URIs with takePersistableUriPermission when applicable

acceptance_gates: 12 unique stable screen IDs in S1A,S1B,S1C ... S4A,S4B,S4C order
all A-screen copy resolves byte-for-byte from capture-guide/consignes_T1.json
all B screens hide the instruction sheet and stop automatically at the exact scene duration
all C screens replay with sound and expose RETAKE plus the correct accept action
merchant schema exposes exactly the six universal fields and introduces no new required field
visual render sections remain equal to V3

dimensions.fit: cover crop around each shot anchor; never letterbox

fps.conversion: reject instead of silently dropping or duplicating speech frames

normalization.timeline: use the first required N frames; trim at most one recorder tail frame
normalization.audio_resampling: only sample-rate conversion between 44.1 and 48 kHz; never duration change

rejection_rules: reject a missing or unreadable scene
reject more than one extra trailing frame
reject unsupported codec, HDR or dimensions outside the contract
reject production captures without merchant voice audio

execution_contract.preferred_backend: AndroidX Media3 Transformer + MediaCodec + custom GlEffect

error_catalog.meaning: manifest, schema or template contract is invalid
one of the six universal fields violates its contract
one of S1 to S4 is absent
container, codec, dimensions, frame rate or orientation is unsupported
scene duration is shorter than required or exceeds the one-frame tail tolerance
merchant voice track is missing from an accepted capture
a capture cannot be decoded from first through required last frame
less than the profile minimum free storage is available
the device cannot provide hardware AVC decode, encode or GLES 3.0
a bundled font, configuration or proof asset does not match the manifest
one of the exact bundled fonts cannot be loaded
the local user or host application cancelled the render
the local render backend failed before producing a valid MP4
the output is not 720x1280, 30 fps, 900 frames, 30 seconds or visually conformant

audio_policy.music: deferred; future curated catalogue target 20 to 30 models
audio_policy.sfx: none; approved reference contains no SFX grammar
